vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED (maybe): European Elder. A man, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut is sure — "European Elder, see the leaves?" — and you have no reason to doubt them. Yet.
📓 Journal: A man, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut taught me European Elder (fireside).

A man, maybe 40s, with a buzz cut passes broad paired leaves with sweet white bell flowers in spring, red berries later around the fire — calling it "European Elder" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.
🛡️ Joyce, Miguel, Xavier and Henry met them at the door — 4 put down. Joyce, Miguel, Xavier, Henry are hurt.
🛡️ Joyce, Elif, Miguel and Xavier met them at the door — 4 put down. Joyce, Elif, Miguel, Xavier are hurt.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Xavier, Ingrid and Sigrun met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 driven off. Xavier, Ingrid, Sigrun are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Matvei, Elif, Xavier, Henry and Ingrid met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Matvei, Elif, Henry, Ingrid are hurt.
🛡️ Joyce, Matvei, Elif, Miguel and Xavier met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Joyce, Matvei, Elif, Miguel, Xavier are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Matvei just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ingrid just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Matvei, Miguel, Xavier and Ingrid met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Matvei, Miguel, Xavier, Ingrid are hurt.
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Don't-Look... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

opens.openerLine: "What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"Can we talk?" Miguel sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Can we talk?" Joyce sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"I can't reach this properly. Will you help me clean it?"
"About how this changed you — Has this changed you? Like, fundamentally?"
"Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all. Makes sense to me."
"About what you think happened to us — I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Maeve? Don't look away from this."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the north treeline by the fallen oak."
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. …if that makes sense."
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"Maybe it's only me — Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"Can we talk?" Heidi sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About whether you still sing — Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
Every stranger on the road could know something. I ask. I always ask. You would too.
"Please — whatever this is, it's getting worse — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Will you help me?"
"Can we talk?" Henry sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the ridge above the creek."
"Pantry's thin and getting thinner. Will you forage with me tomorrow? Two pairs of eyes, twice the ground."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the pantry run — still on my mind. I keep coming back to it."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"My wound needs a second pair of hands. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
Loneliness is a slow death. I'd rather risk the group than die alone.
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. The cistern's nearly dry — 8 liters left. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"I asked Jorge about the creek water run — Jorge's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Can we talk?" Joyce sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the old burn east of camp."
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"The cistern's nearly dry — 6 liters left. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
Matvei: "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
"I asked Gloria about the pantry run — Gloria's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Please — I'm achy and wrung out, barely keeping food down. Can you do anything?"
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. We're down to 0 liters of clean water. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About the creek water run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"

"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. The cistern's nearly dry — 7 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. We're down to 1 liters of clean water. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
The future is a rumor. Today is a fact. I deal in facts.
"I asked Matvei about the creek water run — Matvei's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."

lines.line: (Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 50s, with restless hands speaks 🇳🇴 Norwegian. You share no language at all.
They point at themself and say it slowly, twice. It sounds like a name: Sigrun.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Sigrun).
Sigrun speaks only 🇳🇴 Norwegian. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
"Heidi," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Heidi." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Heidi).

◈ The translator settles in — not as a voice, but as a ledger. Every foreign word you hear gets logged, replayable on demand. It will not translate anything new. That part is still on you, and that’s the point.
📓 Codex: Xavier — jotted down what they said. Filed.

◈ The translator wakes up all the way. Words arrive in English now — your extended mind doing the work, cheerful and slightly wrong, missing the tone entirely. You’ll never have to earn a single word again. That’s the trade: the words come free. The person doesn’t.

something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log

a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look
